enchantments.tooltip: +16 Enhancement Bonus: +16 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Lingering Acidic Burn: This weapon splashes acid on your opponents. Your attacks and offensive spells have a high chance to deal very strong Acid damage over time.
Attacks and offensive spells reduce enemy PRR and MRR by 10 each. This debuff does not stack, but refreshes on each hit.
Acidic 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 7d6 Acid damage on each hit.
Destructive Acid +7: Strikes with this weapon have a small chance to call forth a surge of incredibly corrosive acid, dealing 7d20+72 acid damage.
